admission.justification: An admitted start of a leaf Reviewer or Curator through the product. The cited tests exercise this rule where a regression could change a reader or lifecycle outcome.

applicability: An admitted start of a leaf Reviewer or Curator through the product.
conditions: The start has an exact paired workspace and a resolved recipient.
A genuine new start or replacement gets a fresh notice. A replay of the same start sends no duplicate.
A busy or opening seat uses held delivery under the product sender.
The converted-memory moment uses effectively ignored briefs/_task/ or the recipient's recorded task scratch. The unconverted notice has no moment file.
exclusions: Other roles, edits and extra rounds in the same seat do not produce a start moment.

evidence: W3 F04 mounted dashboard and direct-grant tests for both roles, replay and replacement.

statement: New Reviewer and Curator starts send one bounded product notice, with the moment file in ignored task memory or the recipient's task scratch for converted memory, and a no-file notice for unconverted memory.
